asset_heavy.reason: Asset-based LTL carrier with 9,700 tractors, 34,400 trailers, terminals and service centers needing ongoing expansion.

big_ticket.reason: LTL shipments are small, frequent freight movements billed per shipment, not large infrequent purchases.

cyclical_demand.reason: LTL freight volumes depend on industrial and retail activity and fall in downturns; shippers cut shipments.

large_customers.reason: LTL customers are shippers of every size, including many small and mid-sized businesses, not mainly large enterprises or government.

notes: Judgment call on large_customers: XPO serves shippers of all sizes, including large retailers and grocers.

offers_products.reason: Sells freight transportation; its software tools and trailers built in-house support the service and aren't sold.

offers_services.reason: Provides less-than-truckload freight transportation, pickup, linehaul and delivery services across North America.

people_delivered.reason: Service depends on trucks, trailers, terminal network and technology; an asset-based trucking carrier.

recurring_revenue.reason: Shippers repeatedly ship freight under pricing agreements, giving ongoing repeat volume from the same business customers.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are businesses shipping freight; residential delivery is only a delivery option for business shippers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells LTL freight shipping to businesses such as retailers, grocers, manufacturers and trade-show shippers.
